thread:
Sam: Quick postmortem follow-up: afternoon outage was due to truncated certbundle upload + rapid DNS cache invalidation. Putting owners/ETAs here. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/pm-link-2481

Priya: Observed 3.8x retry spike at 16:18 UTC, mostly ap-southeast -> us-east. LB logs show TLS handshake resets when chain length + header size exceed ~1.5KB.

Marco: Proposed owners:
- Marco: LB resilience patch + canary (due 2026-03-29 04:00 UTC)
- Sam: cert upload validation pipeline + rollback automation (due 2026-03-28 23:00 UTC)
- Nora-netops: PMTU trace + pcap + contact backbone provider (due 2026-03-28 20:00 UTC)
- Priya: DNS TTL rollup + provider failover playbook (due 2026-03-28 14:00 UTC)

incidents-bot: Action created: INC-2026-7124 "Certbundle + DNS churn remediation" assigned to Sam, due 2026-03-28 23:00 UTC.

Marco: Opening PR for handshake-tolerant parsing: https://github.com/redwood/edge/pull/523. Canary on edge-canary-7. ETA EOD.

Sam: I've started a rollback job for the suspect cert artifact on the affected pools. Command used:
```
./infra/tools/cert-rollback --pool=edge-pool-7 --artifact=2026-03-28T15:40Z
```
Posting when done.

Nora-netops: Running mtr/tcpdump from ap-southeast egress. Saw ICMP frag-needed on hop 9 at MTU ~1396B. Uploading pcap to /incidents/7124/pcap.tar.gz

Priya: Rolling DNS TTL from 45 -> 240 for edge zones. Change pushed to provider-B via API, monitoring now. Also enabling provider failover for the zone.

Marco: Added CI test to upload a 2.2KB combined chain and run openssl s_client under load:
```
openssl s_client -connect edge.redwood-inference.com:443 -showcerts < bigchain.pem
wrk -t6 -c200 -d30s https://edge.redwood-inference.com/test
```

Sam: Owners + due dates re-confirmed in incident board. I'll post final postmortem draft by 2026-03-29 12:00 UTC and schedule recurrence reviews weekly for 4 weeks.

Priya: Proposed alert: cross_region_tls_abort_pct > 0.3% for 10m -> P0 page. Lower threshold 0.1% for alert-only. Adding to ops-alerting.

incidents-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled: 2026-03-29 08:00 UTC. This thread will be archived to /incidents/2026/2481234567 for audit.
